metadata.title: Pressekit, fakta og kontakt | Apropos Magazine
metadata.description: Find Apropos Magazines pressekit, logoer og kontakt. Præsentation og fakta om det uafhængige, reklamefri danske kulturmedie og vores redaktionelle dækning.

hero.title: Presse
hero.lead: Præsentation, redaktionel profil og materiale til dig, der vil omtale Apropos Magazine.

boilerplate.heading: Præsentation til omtale
boilerplate.introduction: Vælg den korte eller den udfoldede præsentation af mediet.
boilerplate.short: Apropos Magazine har holdninger, god appetit og sjældent travlt med at gå hjem. Vi skriver om kulturen, der sætter sig i kroppen og giver samtalen noget at leve af. Med nysgerrighed, personlighed og et glimt i øjet. Også når vi er uenige. Uafhængigt, gratis at læse og helt uden reklamer.
boilerplate.long:
Apropos Magazine beskæftiger sig med kulturen, der fylder på scener, skærme, sider og i samtaler. Det uafhængige danske kulturmedie samler anmeldelser, essays og perspektiver på musik, film, tv-serier, bøger, kunst, gaming og kulturliv.

Musikdækningen omfatter koncerter, festivaler og udgivelser. Film og serier undersøges som fortællinger, mens bøger, kunst og spil indgår i en bredere samtale om æstetik, identitet og samfund. Der er plads til både det enkelte værk og den sammenhæng, det bliver en del af. Stilen er personlig, nysgerrig og åben for humor med ambitionen om at gøre kulturen vedkommende og give nye vinkler plads.

Apropos er gratis at læse og bringer ingen annoncer, native advertising eller sponsoreret redaktionelt indhold. Reklamefriheden er dermed en konkret del af mediets profil, både i læseoplevelsen og i det redaktionelle indhold.

Apropos Magazine udgives af Apropos Creative ApS og er for læsere, der ønsker vurderinger og perspektiver på tværs af kulturens mange udtryk.

editorialProfile.heading: Værkerne. Oplevelserne. Samtalen omkring dem.
editorialProfile.introduction: Apropos dækker kultur gennem anmeldelser, essays, guides og kommentarer. Interessen samler sig om værkerne, deres udtryk og de spørgsmål, de åbner: fra en koncerts form og energi til en romans blik på samfundet eller et spils måde at fortælle på.

areas.title: Musik
areas.text: Koncertanmeldelser, festivaldækning, albumanmeldelser og guides til navne på programmet. Med plads til både musikken og kulturen omkring scenerne.

areas.title: Film og tv-serier
areas.text: Anmeldelser af film og serier samt perspektiver på deres fortællinger, karakterer og temaer. Fra den konkrete udgivelse til den kultur, den indgår i.

areas.title: Kunst og design
areas.text: Udstillinger, kunstnere og visuelle udtryk. Artikler om blandt andet portrætkunst, installationer og design, hvor værkets form møder spørgsmål om krop, identitet og offentlighed.

areas.title: Bøger
areas.text: Boganmeldelser og litterære perspektiver med blik for sprog, fortælling og de menneskelige og samfundsmæssige spørgsmål, litteraturen rejser.

areas.title: Gaming
areas.text: Spilanmeldelser og perspektiver på spil som kultur. Fortælling, æstetik og spiloplevelse indgår i vurderingen af de verdener, spillene inviterer ind i.

areas.title: Kultur og samfund
areas.text: Essays og kommentarer om blandt andet identitet, repræsentation, klubkultur og digitale platforme. Her sættes kulturelle fænomener ind i en større samtale.

metadata.title: Press kit, facts and contact | Apropos Magazine
metadata.description: Find the Apropos Magazine press kit, logos and contact details. Facts and editorial coverage from an independent, ad-free Danish culture publication.

hero.title: Press
hero.lead: Descriptions, editorial profile and materials for anyone covering Apropos Magazine.

boilerplate.heading: Descriptions for coverage
boilerplate.introduction: Choose a short or extended description of the publication.
boilerplate.short: Apropos Magazine has opinions, an appetite for culture and little desire to call it a night. We write about what gets under our skin and keeps the conversation going. Curious, personal and with a sense of humour, even when we disagree. Independent, free to read and entirely free of advertising.
boilerplate.long:
Apropos Magazine explores the culture that fills stages, screens, pages and conversations. The independent Danish publication brings together reviews, essays and commentary on music, film, television, books, art, gaming and cultural life.

Its music coverage includes concerts, festivals and releases. Film and television are considered as storytelling, while books, art and games form part of a wider conversation about aesthetics, identity and society. There is room for both an individual work and the context around it. The editorial voice is personal, curious and open to humour, aiming to make culture matter and welcome fresh perspectives.

Apropos is free to read and carries no advertisements, native advertising or sponsored editorial content. Being free of advertising is a tangible part of its identity, both in the reading experience and in its editorial content.

Published by Apropos Creative ApS, Apropos Magazine is for readers seeking judgments and perspectives across many forms of culture.

editorialProfile.heading: The works. The experiences. The conversations around them.
editorialProfile.introduction: Apropos covers culture through reviews, essays, guides and commentary. Its focus is on the works, their expression and the questions they open up: from the form and energy of a concert to a novel's view of society or the way a game tells a story.

areas.title: Music
areas.text: Concert reviews, festival coverage, album reviews and guides to acts on the programme. With room for both the music and the culture around the stages.

areas.title: Film and television
areas.text: Reviews of films and TV series alongside perspectives on their stories, characters and themes. From an individual release to its place in the wider culture.

areas.title: Art and design
areas.text: Exhibitions, artists and visual expression. Coverage includes portraiture, installations and design, where a work's form meets questions about the body, identity and public life.

areas.title: Books
areas.text: Book reviews and literary perspectives that consider language, storytelling and the human and social questions raised by literature.

areas.title: Gaming
areas.text: Game reviews and perspectives on games as culture. Storytelling, aesthetics and gameplay inform assessments of the worlds that games invite players to explore.

areas.title: Culture and society
areas.text: Essays and commentary on subjects including identity, representation, club culture and digital platforms. Cultural phenomena become part of a wider conversation.

advertisementFree.heading: Free to read. Free of advertising.
paragraphs: Apropos Magazine carries no advertisements. Its articles are free to read, and the publication carries neither native advertising nor sponsored editorial content.
Readers can access the culture coverage without advertisements or articles paid for by an advertiser.

rows.label: Advertising
rows.value: No advertisements, native advertising or sponsored editorial content
